Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 5
Reason for Mistake: The Planner arbitrarily redefined “came out” to mean the primary-country wide theatrical release per IMDb and ignored earlier public releases in other regions. This misinterpreted the user’s question (which typically implies the earliest release anywhere) and led to concluding Angali Pangali was earlier, despite evidence that Niyoti had an earlier public release (10 June 2016 in India) than Angali Pangali (17 June 2016).
